subject: Improve header comment and strengthen type checking for entry (#2794)
reason: The change is a pure type-safety refactor of src/entry.c/entry.h and callers in t_hash.c: a rewritten header comment, `typedef void entry` replaced by an opaque `struct _entry` typedef, explicit casts, an `entryGetField()` accessor that returns the same pointer as before ((sds)entry), and a cast-only wrapper for the vset expiry callback. All functional expressions compute identical values on both builds (the new int offset in entryDefrag holds an intra-allocation offset of at most a few dozen bytes, so no truncation), so no runtime behaviour, reply, encoding, persistence or replication path di
